canonical.title: Privacy & Data Minimization Engine
canonical.job: Determines which data is necessary, optional, sensitive, derived, prohibited, retained, or deletable.
canonical.bWeb: A bloated intake shrinks to its justified minimum.

rules: An empty or duplicate-ID inventory cannot pass.
Every collected field is bound to a purpose identifier and accountable owner.
Necessary, sensitive, and derived collection requires a written basis, inspectable evidence reference, and tested no-collection counterfactual.
Sensitive collection and sensitive-source derivation require an active Build 023 permission record whose purpose ID matches the collection purpose.
Permission never turns optional or prohibited data into necessary data.
Derived data identifies its sources, source sensitivity, and derivation logic.
Every collected field has a positive whole-day limit, retention basis, deletion trigger, deletion method, and export/disclosure rule.
A deterministic pass is a control check, not proof of factual necessity, effective deletion, lawful processing, or compliance.
boundaries: Synthetic evidence references and permission records are demonstrations, not independently verified evidence.
Deletion schedules describe planned controls and do not prove deletion occurred.
Synthetic browser-local fixture; do not enter personal data.
Competent review under applicable law remains required.
